To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(i) the divertor heat removal can be achieved in a reasonable manner, (ii) the BB can be designed to be simple and pressure tight, and (iii) the waste management can be downsized.

(1) divertor design is the most critical issue on DEMO, (2) the divertor design window is found, which allows divertor heat removal, (3) the BB design has been optimized to be more compact and simple in structure, (4) downsizing of the radioactive waste management facilities is possible by reducing temporary waste storage.
the design window of divertor plasma and magnetic configuration, the design window of heat sink material, and the design window of BB structure are all found.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following three issues on JA DEMO; (1) the divertor heat removal, (2) the BB structure and (3) the waste management.
the development of DEMO design with a lower Pfus and the reduction of the waste management cost.
the design of a DEMO that is as simple and compact as possible, and is based on existing technologies.

the JA DEMO concept is still in a conceptual phase, but a number of design issues on DEMOs have been resolved in a systematic and comprehensive manner.
the Japanese DEMO design study has reached a stage where it can be regarded as a realistic design study, and that JA DEMO is a good reference design for DEMO.
JA DEMO design has been evolved in a manner to address critical design issues on the basis of the current knowledge, and to be a candidate for a DEMO design.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the design of the steady state JA DEMO is now at a level where it can be considered as the basis of a realistic DEMO plant.

we have made progress in finding solutions for the major design issues, and the JA DEMO concept has been established with a clear path toward the next phase of design study.

the design of JA DEMO is progressing in a stepwise manner, and that the design issues are being resolved one after another.
